scope: User-requested random quarter removal and Menger sponge, and completed box-count reporting choices. Extends original carpet protocol; no fluid change.

quarter.rule: One coin per stage, shared by every connected interval. Remove its second or third quarter. Each parent leaves two connected survivors with contraction ratios 1/4 and 1/2.
quarter.correction: Initial three-equal-child interpretation was excluded and retained locally; corrected connected-interval tracks are used.

menger.rule: Keep 20 of 27 subcubes; retain offsets with at most one center coordinate.
menger.provenance: Exact subsets of a larger independent passive-label batch. No redundant fluid or Menger integration.

box_counts.center: Subtract each cloud mean to remove translation; keep original side 0.375 fixed.
box_counts.interpretation: Finite-scale summaries and sampling controls; no inferred limiting dimension of the fluid.
